result.query:
SELECT TOP 1 [Matt_id] AS [Matt_id], [Indelning_typ] AS [Indelning_typ], [Indelning_etikett] AS [Indelning_etikett], [Kon] AS [Kon], [Alder] AS [Alder], [Matperiod_typ] AS [Matperiod_typ], [Matperiod_char] AS [Matperiod_char], [Matperiod_datum] AS [Matperiod_datum], [Varde] AS [Varde], [Kommentar] AS [Kommentar] 
FROM (SELECT 
	  MBusinessKey as Matt_id
      ,[Version] as version
      ,GroupKey
      ,MTypeBusinessKey as MTypeBusinessKey
      ,[MTypeName] as [MTypeName]
	  ,MName as Namn
    ,GroupTypeName as Indelning_typ
    ,Indelning_typ_desc as Indelning_typ_desc
	  ,Enhet as Enhet
	  ,Kommun as Kommun
	  ,Region as Region_lan
    ,[GroupName] as Indelning_etikett
    ,[MeasurementPeriod] as Matperiod_char
	  ,[measurementperiodtype] as Matperiod_typ
	  ,MeasurementPeriodDate as Matperiod_datum
	  ,PeriodStartYear
	  ,PeriodStartQuarter
	  ,IsLastPeriod
	  ,LastPeriodFilterFlag
    ,[Age]
    ,[Gender]
    ,concat(GroupName, '; ', Age, '; ', Gender) as LegendBase
	   ,[Value] as Varde
	   ,ValueD0
	   ,ValueD1
	   ,ValueD3
    ,ValueD4
    ,ValueChar
    ,[Age] as Alder
    ,[Gender] as Kon
	  ,[numerator] as taljare
	  ,[denominator] as n
	  ,[cihigh] as KI_low
	  ,[cilow] as KI_high
	  ,StandardizingPop as Standpop
	  ,StandardizingPopName
	  ,AgeStandardizedValue
	  ,Crude as Crude
	  ,CrudeCILow as Crude_KI_low
	  ,CrudeCIHigh as Crude_KI_high
    ,[Commentary] as Kommentar
    ,[DataGenerationDate]
	FROM [semantic].[VAI_GONV_Trends]
) AS virtual_table GROUP BY [Matt_id], [Indelning_typ], [Indelning_etikett], [Kon], [Alder], [Matperiod_typ], [Matperiod_char], [Matperiod_datum], [Varde], [Kommentar];
